Like this week I had an opportunity to make a mountain out of a molehill at work if I wanted. I was bummed because the cubicle by the window I wanted was announced it was going to someone else. I legit dwelled for two weeks prior on why I was more deserving. I was just going to wait for the person's last day on the job before I put in a request to move to their space (courtesy). My feelings told me to go to my boss and try to convince them on why I needed that space instead of the other coworker.
